title: RecipeTin's Lamb Ragu
ingredients: Lamb & Seasoning: 1.25 kg boneless lamb shoulder, 1.75 tsp salt, 0.75 tsp black pepper, 2 tbsp olive oil
Soffrito: 1 onion, 2 celery sticks, 1 carrot, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary
Base & Aromatics: 0.25 cup tomato paste, 375 ml red wine, 400 g crushed tomato, 375 ml chicken stock, 2 beef stock cubes, 3 sprigs rosemary, 2 bay leaves
Pasta: 500 g pappardelle, 1 tbsp salt for water, Parmesan for serving
steps: Season lamb and brown in 2 tbsp oil in a large heavy pot on high heat for 2-3 minutes per side, then remove.
Lower heat to medium, add onion, celery, carrot, garlic, and chopped rosemary, cooking slowly for 7-8 minutes.
Turn heat to high, add tomato paste for 1.5 mins, pour in wine and reduce by half while scraping the pot base.
Add tomato, stock, 3 rosemary sprigs, bay leaves, stock cubes, remaining salt/pepper, and lamb; simmer gently covered on low for 2 hours.
Remove and shred lamb; discard herbs, return lamb with 2 fresh rosemary sprigs, and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes.
Boil pasta 1 min under packet time, reserve a mug of water, then toss pasta with ragu over medium-high heat until coated.
